data.name: Oilboy Energy Limited
data.description: Oilboy Energy Limited (the Company) was registered on June 28, 1993 under the repealed Companies Ordinance, 1984 (now the Companies Act, 2017) as a private limited Company and subsequently converted into public limited Company as on June 29, 1994. The shares of the Company are quoted on Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited (PSX). The primary business of the Company is trading of fuel and energy supplies.
